notes: Variables 'Time to Recurrence' and 'Progression' are present in the provided Supplementary Data table.

Unit for 'Time to Recurrence' is inferred as days based on the companion column 'Days_to_Death or Last Contact' and the manuscript text reporting follow-up in days (e.g., median follow-up of 2,284 days).

For patients with Progression = 0, 'Time to Recurrence' appears to equal 'Days_to_Death or Last Contact' (i.e., censoring time) — e.g., Study_ID 32 has Progression=0 and Time to Recurrence = 4661 which equals Days_to_Death or Last Contact.

Progression event subtypes are recorded in the 'ProgType' and 'ProgType_Lab' columns (e.g., 'Systemic', 'Locoregional', 'Secondary.Primary'); the paper defines the progression group as all disease progression events regardless of type.
The manuscript refers to both PFS and RFS in different analyses; the same 'Time to Recurrence'/'Progression' fields from the Supplementary Data are the apparent source for those analyses.
'Days_to_Death or Last Contact' and 'Dead_or_alive' are present in the provided Supplementary Data table.

Coding of 'Dead_or_alive' (1 vs 0) is not explicitly defined in the table documentation but is inferred from the column name and concordance with follow-up times (rows where Dead_or_alive=1 correspond to earlier death times in 'Days_to_Death or Last Contact').
The primary analyses in the paper focus on progression/recurrence (PFS/RFS), but overall survival data (Days_to_Death or Last Contact + Dead_or_alive) are provided in the Supplementary Data.
